# Dead EVF gamma tables

EVF gamma tables in section 1 that the E-P7, which has no EVF, never programs.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x601de13c` to `0x601e3b3c` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [ep7 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/ep7-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-P7](../cameras/ep7.md)

Only the EVF device path reaches them. Do not reuse this range on a body with an EVF. Step-table words at 0x601e3b40..0x601e3d68 point into it.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): One step-table word points to each 256-byte table; the programmer runs only for the EVF. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for E-P7](../projects/caduceus-ep7.md)): Code placed in these tables has run on the camera since test 11. Source: [E-P7 firmware guide](../sources/ep7.guide.md).
